issues.legal_issue: A claim for additional FSI or TDR as compensation for surrendered land and a constructed amenity is not barred by delay or laches where the authority has not shown prejudice or intervening third-party rights.
Delay in pursuing an additional FSI or TDR claim does not, without intentional relinquishment of a known right, establish abandonment or waiver.

Under Section 126(1)(b) of the Maharashtra Regional and Town Planning Act and the applicable Development Control Regulations, additional FSI or TDR for a constructed amenity is measured by the area of the construction or development, subject to the applicable regulatory conditions.
The 2016 amendment to the Development Control Regulations does not retrospectively or retroactively extinguish entitlements that accrued under the earlier regulations.
The interpretation in Godrej & Boyce I governing additional FSI or TDR for amenities is not per incuriam and remains applicable to claims governed by the earlier regulations.
